name: end_story_screens
purpose: The six end-story screens (body runs through the a366/a454 arms and the a476 tail). select_disk(2); load PROPORT.PCS (g_raw_file_names[0]) with load_file_to_mem, TEXT.16 (ptr 0x260c) and END1.16 (ptr 0x261a[0]) with load_image_file, each retried until non-zero; rect_effect dissolve; select_text_window(0). For screen 0..5: swap the picture file when g_end_story_number[s] changes (0x261a[n]); draw page 1, g_display_mode=2, put_char(0xff); if g_end_hook[s]==1: screen 0 draws TEXT.16 images 0 at (0,0xd8) and 4 at (0x1c,0x98), screen 3 images 5 at (0,0xe0) and 0 at (0,0xb0); draw picture g_end_image_index[s] at (g_end_pic_y[s], g_end_pic_x[s]); fill the FONT layout block 0x5146/0x5148 (left x per band from g_end_left_x[2s,2s+1]), 0x514c/0x514e (right x from g_end_right_x), 0x5150/0x5152 (band y from g_end_para1_y/para2_y), 0x5156 (g_end_first_line_x), 0x5158 (g_end_text_y); load END.DAT at g_end_text_offsets[s] (2000 bytes) to 0xb21e and draw it with FONT draw_proportional_text; screens 1..5 wait for a key; copy_page(0,1). Free picture, TEXT.16 and font. Tail: wait key, draw page 1, put_char(0xff), load ENDSC.16 (ptr 0x2622), draw_image(0,0,0x28,0), free, copy_page(0,1), draw page 0, g_display_mode=0.

0x3da6.name: g_end_left_x
0x3da6.meaning: left x per band per screen

0x3db2.name: g_end_right_x
0x3db2.meaning: right x per band per screen

notes: Initial story number 0x31 forces the first compare to differ and reload END1.16 (the preloaded one is freed first).

name: end_story_screen0_fragment
purpose: Not a function: screen-0 title arm of end_story_screens (JZ target); another overlay's vector 1778:0326 lands here.

name: end_story_screen3_fragment
purpose: Not a function: screen-3 title arm of end_story_screens (JMP target, jumps back to a385).

name: end_story_finale_fragment
purpose: Not a function: tail of end_story_screens (JMP from a452): key wait, ENDSC.16, text mode.

name: append_wrapped_word
purpose: Copies s into the line buffer 0xbcb2 at length byte 0xbcda while < 39, NUL-terminates; if the last stored char is '\n' print_string(0xbcb2) and length=0.

name: append_number_word
purpose: n>20: append tens word 0x3e2e[n/10] (Twenty..Ninety), n%=10, return n/10 if 0, else append '-' (0x82c6); then append 0x3e0a[n] ('',One..Twenty). Return unused.

name: append_ordinal_word
purpose: n<13: 0x3e40[n] (First..Twelfth); n<20: number word + 'th'; n==20: 'Twent'+'ieth'; else 'Twent'+'y-'+0x3e18[n] (= First.. for 21..).

name: print_quest_report
purpose: Certificate: cursor (1,0), put_char 0xfd/0xfc, 'Be it known that on', 'the '+ordinal(day)+' Day of', 'the '+ordinal(month)+' Month', 'of the Year', number(year/100)+' Hundred', number(year%100), name+' the Avatar', five fixed lines, font-1 'THE QUEST OF THE AVATAR IS FOREVER', 0xfd, 'Report now, thy Quest compleat in' + elapsed time since year 139 month 4 day 5 (days<0: day+23 and month-5; months<0: +13 and year-140) as itoa years/months/days with plurals and commas, 'to Lord British at Origin Systems!', then an infinite loop.
notes: itoa reimplemented inline into a with_buf scratch buffer; the final hang pumps the window via wait_ticks.

name: move_slot_toward
proto: uint move_slot_toward(uint target_y, uint target_x, int slot)
purpose: Returns 0 if slot tile is 0 or already at target; else steps y toward target when |dx|<|dy| else x, end_step_pause, returns 1.

name: wander_slot
purpose: If tile!=0 and rand_range(1,0): up to 8 tries of a random step (0 x+1, 1 x-1, 2 y+1, 3 y-1) onto a g_view_tiles cell == 0x44 ('D' floor). animate_wait(1).

name: endgame_sequence
purpose: Vector 1778:04ca (SJOG end_combat / DUNGEON on g_combat_exit 'M'). active combatant 0xff, status redraw, driver_tile_patch_special(1) (tile patch cmd 4), MISCMAPS.DAT 0x210 (11x16) -> g_view_objects -> g_light_map rows, ENDMSG.DAT (1000) -> 0xb21e; clear all slot tiles; slot 0x1f = Lord British tile 0x7c at (5,8); wait 40; walk to (5,3). Per member: dead -> name+' lives!', 'G', hp=max, flash+sweep(1,5000,40000,1,0x2260), status; figure tile 0x1ade[index of class in 'AMBFDTPRS'] in slot m at (5,9), walked to (0x3e5a[m],0x3e60[m]). Wait 40, ENDMSG 0xb21e+name+'!"', key, 0xb23f, Y/N (echo Yes/No); N -> 0xb267 and ask again. Y with g_sandalwood_box: LB to (5,4),(5,5); box slot 6 tile 0xe at (5,4); 0xb2c9; 'He says:'; texts 0xb2f1,0xb346,0xb385,0xb3e7,0xb42f,0xb469 with keys; box tile 8; key; sweep(1,10000,50000,1,0x1450); box cleared; light_map[4][5]=0xdc; moongate height 1..16; LB to (5,4) and cleared; each member to (5,4) and cleared; height 15..0; draw_tile(4,5,0x44); page 1 black (set_color 0, free_picture, fill_rect); page 0; end_story_screens; print_quest_report. Else '"I see...', 0xb4f3, slot 0 y-1, step, slots 2/0x1f/0 walk to (8,6)/(4,1)/(8,4), then wander slots 1,3,4,5 forever.

0x5d52.name: g_end_lb_slot
0x5d52.meaning: monster slot 0x1f used for Lord British

0x5c8a.name: g_end_box_slot
0x5c8a.meaning: monster slot 6 used for the sandalwood box

notes: s_STARTSC_16+10 and s_Missed_+1 are the numbers 5000 and 10000.
